claims.claim: Conversion error on a continuous-time dynamic graph accumulates along the event axis and contains a term proportional to the change in the neighbor-aggregation operator ||A_k - A_{k-1}||.
claims.mechanism: Lift the layer conversion identity to the event recursion epsilon_k <= rho*epsilon_{k-1} + L_A*||A_k-A_{k-1}||*||s_{k-1}|| + c/T + eta_k; the topology term is absent from static conversion and RL continuous control.
claims.falsifying_ablation: A3 frozen static base, A5 ||delta A|| quartile stratification, A4 frozen-topology control, per-event bound-violation rate.
claims.primary_metric: Slope of per-event state error epsilon_k against cumulative ||A_k-A_{k-1}|| (higher), plus bound-violation rate (lower).
claims.minimum: A measurable non-zero slope with paired bootstrap 95 percent CI excluding zero on the primary stream.
claims.expected_strong: Monotone dose-response across four topology-change quartiles, zero bound violations within numerical tolerance, replication on Wikipedia, MOOC and Enron.
claims.failure: Slope CI contains zero, no monotone dose-response, or bound (1) empirically violated.
claims.simple_baseline: B1 EdgeBank_infty (global binary memory) and B2 Base3 k=10 for teacher sanity; C0 hard-reset IF for conversion sanity.
claims.strong_baseline: C4 CRPI-style global cross-step residual carry-over adapted from arXiv:2601.21778 (ICML 2026), implemented as a direct rerun control.
claims.split_protocol: Chronological 70/15/15 on Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7213796; 1024 validation and 4096 test query IDs SHA-256 frozen at P2; validation alone selects T, gamma and calibration percentile; test read once at P5; IDs disclosed as non-blind.
claims.assumptions: A1-A7 in theoretical-feasibility-audit.md: measured Lipschitz rho of the state update, normalized aggregation operator A_k, ReLU/clip teacher with folded BN, label-free calibration covering the activation range, consistent threshold/gauge, frozen event order, small T.
claims.matched_control: C0: same frozen ANN teacher converted with rate-coded IF, hard reset, no calibration; B0 unconverted ANN teacher as oracle upper bound.
claims.implementation_path: Independent reimplementation of DCGS signed multi-level differential coding, 512-bin label-free histogram calibration, and affine static-base caching for a genuine L-layer dynamic-graph GCN with measured normalised adjacency A_k; all in the v3 run root.
claims.prototype_check: P2 must build A_k, run one L-layer GNN forward, convert one ReLU site with DCGS, and complete a 30-minute single-seed end-to-end smoke before the full matrix is released.
claims.calibration_evidence: Measured three-seed static-graph prior range from ZtL-sysu/gnn2snn: T=4/T=8 teacher agreement 99.28-99.98 percent, GatedGCN CIFAR10 T4 99.55 +/- 0.16 percent. Stated as prior ranges from a different project, not as this project's results.
claims.test_isolation: Test query IDs are hash-frozen at P2 and read once at P5; IDs were used in a predecessor local project and are disclosed as non-blind. Main claim rests on paired within-run comparisons, not absolute MRR.
claims.stop_return_condition: Return to scenario/method design before P2 if the 30-minute prototype fails, measured rho is unbounded with no repair, validation clipping rate exceeds 1 percent with no percentile repair, the ANN teacher fails the v2 non-vacuity condition (validation MRR below 5x chance), the CRPI-style control cannot be implemented, or bound (1) is empirically violated. A missed binding target at P5 enters the versioned correction loop, never a post-hoc target reduction.

claims.claim: Topology-change-gated residual carry-over reduces end-of-window teacher-to-SNN decision disagreement at small T relative to hard reset and to global carry-over.
claims.mechanism: Carry residual membrane potential forward for touched nodes (removes eta_k) and recompute the static base, threshold and shared residual prefix only when relative neighbor-set change delta_v(k) exceeds gamma (attacks the ||delta A|| term).
claims.falsifying_ablation: A2 no carry-over, A1 no topology gate, C4 matched recomputation-budget comparison, S1 T sweep in {1,2,4,8}.
claims.primary_metric: agreement@K: fraction of evaluation queries in the last segment of a 10000-event window where converted SNN argmax equals the frozen ANN teacher argmax (higher), 5 seeds, paired bootstrap 95 percent CI.
claims.minimum: T=4 agreement@K at least 95.0 percent and MRR retention at least 95.0 percent on Wikipedia, with the ANN teacher non-vacuous (validation MRR at least 5x the chance level 1/C) and all per-seed values retained. Absolute comparison against EdgeBank/Base3 is context, not a gate (contract v2).
claims.expected_strong: T=4 agreement@K at least 98.5 percent and MRR retention at least 99.0 percent; over a 10000-event window TCAR mean per-event state error epsilon_k strictly lower than every other control and ablation on each stream, paired epsilon_C4 minus epsilon_M0 bootstrap 95 percent CI excluding zero on all three streams and BH q below 0.05 (pilot 0.0099 vs 0.0393 for C4); direction replicated on MOOC and Enron. Relative reduction and topology stratification are reported diagnostics, not gates.
claims.failure: T=8 agreement@K below 95 percent, or TCAR not strictly lowest in epsilon_k, or paired CI contains zero on any stream, or BH q at least 0.05, or bound (1) violated.
claims.simple_baseline: C0 hard-reset rate-coded IF with no calibration, on the identical teacher.
claims.strong_baseline: C4 CRPI-style global carry-over plus C1 SNNC-AP-light calibration, C2 DCGS graded differential coder, C3 QCFS/FTBC clipped conversion.

claims.claim: The event-triggered recomputation policy binds conversion overhead to topology-change events rather than to total events.
claims.mechanism: Recompute a node's static base and threshold only when delta_v(k) > gamma; between such events reuse the cached base, so recalibration count scales with topology-change events.
claims.falsifying_ablation: A1 recompute-every-event at matched accuracy, S2 gamma sweep over at most six values, A4 frozen-topology control.
claims.primary_metric: Recalibration trigger rate as a fraction of processed events (lower), with graded-event count, parameter count and local PyTorch milliseconds per event as supporting cost quantities.
claims.minimum: Recalibration triggered on at most 50 percent of events with no accuracy loss versus A1.
claims.expected_strong: Recalibration triggered on at most 20 percent of events with no accuracy loss versus A1 and a visible cost-accuracy Pareto frontier across the gamma sweep; direction replicated on three streams.
claims.failure: No cost-accuracy trade-off appears across the gamma sweep, or the trigger rate does not depend on measured topology change.
claims.simple_baseline: A1 recompute at every event (upper-cost control) and B0 ANN teacher inference with no events.
claims.strong_baseline: C4 global carry-over with no recomputation (lower-cost control).
